name: kotoba-live
description: Real-time Japanese to Thai subtitle translator for browser tab audio

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
